estimates.assumptions: 1 large cucumber ≈ 300g edible portion, raw, unpeeled (USDA: ~3.6g carbs/100g)
1 medium fennel bulb ≈ 250g, trimmed and sliced, raw (USDA: ~7.3g carbs/100g incl. ~3g fiber)
150ml full-fat sour cream (≈ 150g); standard 16% fat variety (USDA: ~5g carbs/100g)
Juice of 1 medium lemon ≈ 45ml / 50g, no peel or pith (USDA: ~9g carbs/100g)
1 bunch fresh dill ≈ 20g edible leaves only, no stalks (USDA: ~7g carbs/100g incl. ~2g fiber/10g)
